task_fulfillment.rationale: Both Word deliverables and a reasoned Vendrax recommendation are supplied, but material corrections are needed. The switching-impact figures compare standalone supplier totals without retaining Juvoxa expenditure already paid. Under the report's full-payment assumption, Vendrax's incremental impact is INR 306.39 Mn before recovery and INR 302.79 Mn after the requested refund, not INR 294.39/290.79 Mn. Actual paid amounts must remain conditional. The report also says termination has been issued although the companion email still requires contract references before sending. Early-stage validation context is omitted. Page counts cannot be verified from text extraction; rendering is a separate endpoint.
